summary: XTL Biopharmaceuticals Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing notice of an Extraordinary General Meeting on June 22, 2026, to approve the acquisition of up to 100% of Psyga Bio Ltd. in exchange for ADSs/warrants, a related private placement of up to $1.5M from an interested party, and an authorized share capital increase. The filing is a routine proxy/meeting notice for shareholder approval of an M&A transaction; it does not itself constitute a special-situation event under the classification scheme. The registrant is the filer, and no deal terms are stated in this excerpt.
